title: Can surface chlorophyll represent the water column?
query:
Using the supplied papers and CMOMS data, propose and test a hypothesis about when surface chlorophyll is an unreliable indicator of water-column chlorophyll. Identify a physically interpretable condition under which the relationship changes.

Formulate one specific, falsifiable hypothesis before testing it. Define the test, a plausible alternative explanation, and the conditions for rejecting the hypothesis. Report whether the evidence supports, contradicts, or cannot resolve it.
